set.body:
Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-1.0; milestone-inputs.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: 7c9f9f04 timing/support production code and f1c82af6 landing are present; retained evidence/recall-intake-support-20260922 qualifies components. The last handoff explicitly left legacy immediate-child supportCoverage and broader adoption open.

Remaining / next action: Finish recursive/declared support-coverage migration and facade/exchange adoption of stable words, timing and exact per-axis unions. Preserve separate inference/organization/display units and missing timing.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Governing plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md (2026-09-19); ADR 0019. Key: projection; lane: next.

Scope: recall RecallTiming extraction, codec unit_words/support tables

Acceptance criteria:
1. Stable transcript-bound UTF-16 word IDs and explicit unit membership survive segmentation changes; unit IDs change when unitization changes. Unicode/newline/quoted input and missing/onset-only/interval timing are explicit.
2. Keep inference_unit, organization_unit and projection_unit distinct. Word copying does not create event-transition observations; audio timing is not needed for transcript-order analysis.
3. Support uses per-axis interval unions with complete/partial/unknown coverage and separate display hull. Missing child loci cannot create full group support; duplicates/foreign axes refuse.
4. Optional time-grid projection states W/P/H and exposure/allocation policy, preserves missing recall exposure and external/unprojectable mass. No silent uniform scene-to-second or next-onset-as-offset rule.

Validation: proposed RecallProjectionSuite on recall platforms; exact integer >2^53 and non-BMP consumer fixture

Completion evidence: exact baseline/result SHA, executable command and bound test totals/exit, artifact digests, discriminating failure injection, compatibility impact, separate SD6 review. Run reference-scope for the actual diff and SD2 checkAll before landing. Proposed suite names below are acceptance specifications, not existing or executed tests. No efficacy claim follows from a synthetic pass.

Boundary: Minimal source/word tables first; dense matrices and new granularity models deferred.

2026-09-22 operative workflow reconciliation (docs/plans/2026-09-22-recall-encoding-workflow.md):
This ticket owns stable words, unit membership, observed/onset-only/interval timing, occurrence-qualified exact support and explicit timing missingness. It establishes the checked inputs for the separately tracked temporal-query slice. Criterion 4 is the projection contract boundary, not a requirement to implement dense temporal matrices here. Do not hold the final onset to the transcript end or infer word durations without a named policy. Keep source extent, target ambiguity, localization allocation and clock uncertainty distinct; preserve exact ticks and scan-break metadata independently of composed playback. The temporal-query follow-on owns allocation-free bounds, declared kernels, grids and precision-at-resolution. The closed Sherlock ClockRepair integration does not certify raw scanner coordinates.
